us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: US jobless claims fall to lowest level since mid-July
bullets: Initial unemployment claims fell to 194,000 last week.
AP reported layoffs remain low across the labor market.
The next October jobs report is due Friday, November 6.

articles.title: Fed-tracked inflation gauge accelerates before midterms
bullets: A key Federal Reserve inflation gauge rose last month.
Affordability remains central in the midterm campaign.
AP said voters remain sour on rising costs.

articles.title: US economy grows at 3.4% annual rate in third quarter
bullets: GDP expanded at a 3.4% annual pace from July through September.
Consumer spending helped drive the stronger growth.
AI investment also contributed to the quarterly acceleration.

articles.title: Judge rejects federal bid to segregate California ballots
bullets: A federal judge denied the Trump administration’s request.
The case involved up to 20,000 California ballots.
The judge warned the move would disrupt voting already underway.

articles.title: Trump and Obama rally voters in pivotal midterm states
bullets: Trump campaigned in Ohio during the closing midterm stretch.
Obama rallied Democrats in suburban Atlanta, Georgia.
Both parties sharpened messages before next week’s elections.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Spain observes silence after deadly Madrid train crash
bullets: Dozens gathered in Madrid for a minute of silence.
AP’s roundup said the crash killed 68 people.
The story led international headlines on October 29.

articles.title: US grants visas to Bolsonaro family, AP summary says
bullets: AP’s news summary reported US visas for Flávio Bolsonaro and family.
The development came amid wider international political coverage.
The story appeared in AP’s October 29 news summary.

articles.title: Oil rises as global markets digest Fed pause
bullets: Reuters reported Brent rose 1.5% in global trading.
WTI crude gained 3% in the same market update.
The moves followed the Federal Reserve’s hold decision.

articles.title: Israeli shekel falls sharply after election
bullets: Reuters reported the shekel dropped 2% after Israel’s election.
It was its biggest fall since post-October 7 trading.
The move appeared in a wider global markets update.

articles.title: Samsung posts record profit on AI chip demand
bullets: Samsung reported record quarterly operating profit.
AI memory-chip demand drove the earnings surge.
The results lifted attention on Asian chipmakers.

articles.title: Indian news publishers challenge privacy law in Supreme Court
bullets: Twenty-one Indian publishers challenged the government’s privacy legislation.
They warned the law could threaten investigative journalism.
Reuters reporting was summarized in Tabla’s India roundup.

articles.title: India Supreme Court scrutinizes electoral-roll revision
bullets: The Hindu current-affairs roundup highlighted Supreme Court scrutiny.
The issue concerns Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls.
The item appeared in October 29 India coverage.

articles.title: Cyclone Arnab aftermath features in national coverage
bullets: October 29 coverage tracked the aftermath of Cyclone Arnab.
The story was listed among major Indian developments.
The report focused on national response and impacts.

articles.title: Delhi-NCR air pollution response draws renewed attention
bullets: Delhi-NCR’s pollution response was highlighted in October 29 coverage.
The story focused on air-quality management measures.
It appeared alongside other major national developments.

articles.title: India’s gene-edited agriculture advances make headlines
bullets: Indian coverage noted advances in agricultural gene editing.
The topic appeared in October 29 current-affairs analysis.
It was framed as a key science and agriculture development.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top US market movers and market themes

articles.title: Alphabet disappoints investors after quarterly revenue miss
bullets: Alphabet’s quarterly revenue disappointed investors.
AP said shares pressured US futures and global markets.
Concerns focused on AI spending versus sales growth.

articles.title: Tesla weakness weighs on megacap stock trading
bullets: Reuters said Tesla traded softer during Wednesday’s choppy session.
Megacap weakness offset gains in chip stocks.
Investors awaited Fed decisions and major tech earnings.

articles.title: Apple declines as megacaps lag chip gains
bullets: Reuters reported Apple weakness during Wednesday trading.
The decline came as chipmakers gained on AI demand signals.
The broader market stayed choppy before the Fed decision.

articles.title: Micron jumps as memory-chip optimism lifts semiconductors
bullets: Reuters reported Micron rose about 4.8% intraday.
The move followed strong SK Hynix memory results.
AI demand continued supporting chip-sector sentiment.

articles.title: Amazon watched closely ahead of October 29 earnings
bullets: Investors focused on Amazon’s cloud growth and capex.
Its earnings were scheduled after market close October 29.
The report followed mixed reactions to other Big Tech results.

articles.title: Samsung profit hits record as AI memory demand surges
bullets: Samsung reported 107.4 trillion won in quarterly operating profit.
AI memory chips powered the record result.
The earnings underscored strong global chip demand.

articles.title: DoorDash reportedly explores Instacart deal near $17 billion
bullets: Axios cited Reuters and WSJ reporting on a possible deal.
The potential transaction was valued around $17 billion.
Reports said pricing could exceed $70 per Instacart share.

articles.title: Ares Capital agrees to buy MidCap Financial Investment
bullets: Ares Capital agreed to acquire MidCap Financial Investment.
Axios reported the deal value at $2.6 billion.
The transaction includes cash and stock consideration.

articles.title: Abbott plans to spin off nutrition business
bullets: Axios reported Abbott plans a nutrition-business spinoff.
The unit would become an independent publicly traded company.
The move is part of broader corporate-action news.

articles.title: Private-equity role in housing becomes campaign issue
bullets: Axios reported candidates criticizing corporate private-equity influence.
The issue surfaced during a New Hampshire Senate campaign stop.
Housing affordability remains a prominent political and business concern.

tech.label: Tech

articles.title: AI demand drives Samsung’s record chip profit
bullets: Samsung’s latest profit record was driven by AI chip demand.
Memory chips used in AI systems led growth.

articles.title: AI-linked software flaws fuel cybersecurity concerns

Security researchers tracked AI-discovered flaws and attacks.
Companies building AI systems warned of cyber risks.

bullets: Axios reported Anthropic publicly filed for an IPO.

The filing highlighted major losses and rapid revenue growth.

bullets: A tech roundup cited Reuters on DOJ inquiries.
The probe concerns Nvidia’s Hugging Face transaction.
Regulators continue examining Nvidia’s AI market conduct.

articles.title: Alphabet results raise questions about AI investment returns
bullets: Alphabet revenue disappointed investors after heavy AI spending.

The report pressured tech sentiment and US futures.
